observations.title: Discard a stack with last-item recovery
observations.player_action: Drop unwanted items into the trash slot; take the last stored trash back out to undo that deletion.
observations.outcome: The slot holds the latest deleted item for recovery, rather than guaranteeing a history of all discarded stacks.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Delete the hovered stack or matching items
observations.player_action: Use Delete on the hovered item, or Shift+Delete for items of the same type, unless remapped.
observations.outcome: The shortcuts discard one targeted stack or matching inventory items.

observations.title: Place the trash slot beside a supported screen
observations.player_action: Drag the slot to the desired position or disable it for that screen.
observations.outcome: The trash control can be repositioned across supported interfaces.
conditions: The server and interested clients need the feature; not every connected player must install it.
